verdict.rationale: v0 emphasizes one-click deploy to Vercel's own infrastructure and GitHub push/export code, which allows deploying elsewhere via exported code, but there is no first-party support or documentation for direct deployment to non-Vercel hosts (e.g., AWS, Netlify, self-hosted servers) beyond pushing code to a repo. missing for 10: explicit support/instructions for deploying to external hosts or self-managed infrastructure beyond GitHub push, independent confirmation that exported/GitHub code deploys successfully outside Vercel.
